gates.note: Every statement cell is read from the issuer's own PDF with page, note and hash, and every Kideco figure is checked on its release page. FY 2025 revenue, cost of revenue, profit to owners and total assets agree exactly with the notes; H1 2026 differs from the release only by rounding to US$ million. Escalated: Kideco figures come from results releases in US$ million and million tonnes, rounded to one decimal; Kideco gross profit is not disclosed for 9M 2024 or 9M 2025, so Q4 2024, Q3 2025 and Q4 2025 have no unit economics, and Q3 2024 has no Kideco revenue.

gates.name: Driver model
gates.note: History rebuilds cost of revenue, gross profit, profit before tax, profit and profit to owners with zero gaps. Escalated: unit economics cover Kideco only; the issuer does not split Kideco's cost beyond royalty, so contractor, fuel, freight and depreciation sit in one unsplit line; the royalty is the group note line, taken as Kideco's (it agrees with Kideco's cash cost with and without royalty within rounding).

gates.name: Calibration
gates.note: Forecast volume and strip ratio follow the issuer's 2026 budget; price, royalty rate and cost per bcm are 6M 2026 figures held flat; other businesses and items below gross profit are H1 2026 run rates. Escalated: the 2026 budget price is lower than 6M 2026 actual; Awak Mas gold and any change in the coal price are not modelled.

gates.name: Intake and tie-out
gates.note: Every income statement, revenue-note and cost-of-revenue-note figure was read from the issuer's nine statements (H1 2024 to H1 2026) and foots in both columns of each document: gross profit, profit before tax, profit, owners plus non-controlling interests, note lines to the note total, and note totals to the face. FY25 revenue, cost of revenue, profit to owners and total assets agree with the 2025 Annual Report. Escalated: the issuer regroups cost-of-revenue note lines between filings (equipment rental into mining costs, revegetation and rehabilitation into reclamation, small lines into others), so the same period differs line by line between its first printing and its later comparative; the H1 2026 tie-outs are against a news release rounded to US$1 million; sales, production and stripping ratio are rounded to 0.1 Mt and 0.1x in the presentations.

gates.name: Driver model
gates.note: Rebuilt revenue, cost of revenue and profit to owners equal the reported figures in every historical period (gap rows are zero). Escalated: quarters are each period's year-to-date statement less the previous one as first printed, so in Q3 2024 and Q3 2025 a reclassification shows as a negative 'others' quarter (US$-4.5m and US$-0.5m) while the cost total is exact; overburden is derived as stripping ratio times production, both rounded to one decimal; transport is driven per tonne sold because tonnes hauled are not disclosed.

gates.name: Calibration
gates.note: Forecast volumes come from the issuer's own FY26 targets (sales 26.9-27.5 Mt, production 22.0-22.9 Mt, Q3 production 5.9 Mt; Analysts Meeting 2Q26 pp13, 15); cost drivers, price, purchases and the royalty rate are H1 2026 averages. Escalated: the price is held flat with no view on the coal market; the 2Q26 fuel-price rise (US$1.15 per litre) is averaged with 1Q26; no back-test was run.

gates.name: Intake and tie-out
gates.note: Every income statement, note 26 and note 27a figure was read from the issuer's PDFs and foots: the note lines sum to the note total and to cost of revenue on the face, and every comparative agrees with the earlier filing (180 pairs, no restatement). Escalated: the Q3 and Q4 2024 sales, production, stripping-ratio and transport volumes come from an image-only slide (Corporate Presentation FY2024 pp9-10) read visually; two H1 2026 tie-outs differ only by the presentation's rounding to Rp 10 bn.

gates.name: Driver model
gates.note: Rebuilt revenue, cost of revenue and profit to owners equal the reported figures in every historical period (gap rows are zero). Escalated: overburden is derived as the issuer's stripping ratio (two decimals) times production, so cost per bcm carries that rounding; the issuer does not disclose the stripping ratio for Q3 and Q4 2025, so overburden and the per-bcm drivers are missing in those two quarters.

gates.name: Calibration
gates.note: Forecast drivers are H1 2026 averages, the same quarter of 2025 scaled by the H1 2026 / H1 2025 volume ratios, and the issuer's FY2026 stripping-ratio guidance of 5.63x. Escalated: no volume or price guidance is published in the documents used, so price is held flat at Q2 2026 and inventory change at zero; no back-test was run.
